name: secdeva/fieldTypes/dataCategories

enumValues.enumDescription: Data relating to an identified or identifiable person
Passwords, API keys and shared secrets.
Private keys, symmetric keys, certificates and seeds
Session tokens, access tokens and refresh tokens.
Audit trails, event journals, alarm and event history. The recorded past.
How the product is set up: parameters, policy and rules. Persistent, changed deliberately, usually by an administrator.
Setpoints, commands, recipes and actuation requests. Data that determines what the product, or the equipment it drives, actually does.
The data the product exists to handle: process values, measurements, live alarm state, transactions, orders, documents and records.
Update payloads, signed artefacts and control programs.
Data about the product sent back to the manufacturer: usage, diagnostics and crash reports. Not data the product handles for the customer.
Data whose corruption or loss has health, safety or environmental consequences.

description: The categories of data that this element stores, processes or transmits
